description: Targeted visual reviews of high-value ambiguous groups, using committed renders or a handful of targeted renders (no bulk decode). 'confirm' lifts evidence quality for that group; family_reviews are informational.

family_reviews.note: Composed maps are 2D tile art (interiors with detailed furniture/props, forests, caves; magenta = transparent): strong prop/motif library but a different projection/art language from Platinum's 3D world; motif/redraw use only, no direct import.
family_reviews.reviewed_by: claude (agent visual review of committed/targeted renders; not human-approved)

family_reviews.note: Tiled-background bundles (NCGR+NCLR+NSCR) cannot be rendered by the available package renderer; kept needs_evidence until a tilemap preview exists.
